name: Tracegate
tagline: See the path. Review the evidence.
description: Tracegate is a fictional cloud and identity security concept for reviewing configuration findings, effective access, and potentially reachable paths together.
audience: Audience hypothesis: cloud security teams reviewing combined exposures, with platform engineering as the change-review partner and security operations as a secondary audience.
promise: Turn connected risk into a clear next step.

colors.name: Signal
colors.role: Actions, paths, and points of emphasis

colors.name: Campaign peach
colors.role: Warm campaign surface and connected-system artwork

voice.do: Review the permissions and conditions that could expose a sensitive resource.
Connect identity permissions to exposed cloud resources.
Review the evidence. Test and approve a scoped change.
A synthetic environment illustrates an intended review workflow.
voice.avoid: Trusted by thousands. Guaranteed to stop every breach.

messaging.message: Your cloud and identity risks belong in the same conversation.
messaging.proof: Show the relationship between a principal, its permissions, and the resource it can reach.

messaging.message: Review the path and the reasons to prioritize it.
messaging.proof: Use reachability, business context, and permission scope to explain prioritization.

messaging.message: Prepare the handoff. Keep the decision with the owner.
messaging.proof: Route evidence to an owner and make proposed changes reviewable.

disclosure: Tracegate is a fictional company created as a design and development portfolio project. Product behavior, organizations, people, and environments shown here are illustrative.
